displayContent.text:
name: OMP Multi-Repo Orchestrator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_title:
        description: 'Tiêu đề nhiệm vụ (Task Title)'
        required: true
        default: 'Review & Verify Codebase across repos'
      task_body:
        description: 'Chi tiết yêu cầu / Checklist bàn giao'
        required: true
        default: 'Kiểm tra trạng thái build, test và chất lượng mã nguồn backend, app, web.'
      target_branch:
        description: 'Tên branch thực thi (Tùy chọn)'
        required: false
        default: ''

jobs:
  run-agent:
    # CHỈ CHÍNH CHỦ (babydanh) MỚI ĐƯỢC PHÉP CHẠY.
    if: |
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' && github.event.issue.user.login == github.repository_owner)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360 # Giới hạn tối đa 6 tiếng theo quy định GitHub Actions

    # CUNG CẤP DATABASE POSTGRESQL & REDIS CHO CHUỖI E2E TEST
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgis/postgis:15-3.3-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: your_password
          POSTGRES_DB: tournament_db
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      redis:
        image: redis:7.4-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: 1. Checkout Orchestrator Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 2. Cài đặt Node.js 22 LTS
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: 2.1 Cài đặt Bun (bắt buộc cho OMP runtime)
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: 2.2 Cài đặt Python 3.12 (bắt buộc cho AST-grep & OMP Python tools)
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: 2.3 Cài đặt PNPM toàn cục
        run: npm install -g pnpm

      - name: 2.4 Cài đặt Flutter SDK
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.29.x'
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # Chromium sẽ chỉ được tải khi thực sự cần chạy Playwright UI Test

      - name: 3. Cài đặt OMP (@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent)
        run: |
          npm install -g @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent
          omp --version

      - name: 3.1 Cài đặt Ripwire MCP (Code Intelligence)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          echo "Installing Ripwire for Linux x64..."
          RIPWIRE_REPO=redhat-et/ripwire RIPWIRE_INSTALL_YES=1 bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redhat-et/ripwire/main/scripts/install.sh)" || true
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          ~/.local/bin/ripwire --version || ripwire --version || echo "Ripwire ready or skipped"

      - name: 4. Clone các Repositories của dự án
        env:
          GH_PAT: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p workspace
          cd workspace
          git config --global user.name "OMP Orchestrator Agent"
          git config --global user.email "agent@oh-my-pi.local"

          echo "Cloning Backend repo..."
          git clone https://${GH_PAT}@github.com/$OWNER/HethongBackendApi_QuanlyGiaiDau.git backend || echo "Backend repo not accessible or already cloned"

          echo "Cloning Frontend App repo..."
          git clone https://${GH_PAT}@github.com/$OWNER/HethongFrontEndApp_QLgiaidau.git app || echo "App repo not accessible or already cloned"

          echo "Cloning Frontend Web repo..."
          git clone https://${GH_PAT}@github.com/$OWNER/HethongFrontEndWeb_QLgiaidau.git web || echo "Web repo not accessible or already cloned"

          echo "Cloning AICheckVAR repo..."
          git clone https://${GH_PAT}@github.com/$OWNER/AICheckVAR.git aicheckvar || echo "AICheckVAR repo not accessible or already cloned"

          echo "Cloning Auto3Dvideo repo..."
          git clone https://${GH_PAT}@github.com/$OWNER/Auto3Dvideo.git auto3dvideo || echo "Auto3Dvideo repo not accessible or already cloned"

          echo "Cloning Auto25D-Remotion repo..."
          git clone https://${GH_PAT}@github.com/$OWNER/Auto25D-Remotion.git auto25d-remotion || echo "Auto25D-Remotion repo not accessible or already cloned"

          ls -la

      - name: 5. Đồng bộ cấu hình OMP hoàn chỉnh (Codex + OpenRouter + Jev + 70+ Skills)
        env:
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          GH_PAT: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}
          OMP_CODEX_AUTH: ${{ secrets.OMP_CODEX_AUTH }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.omp/agent

          # Sao chép toàn bộ kho 70+ Skills và Luật Agent từ repo vào ~/.omp/agent
          echo "Copying 70+ Skills and agent directives..."
          cp -r skills ~/.omp/agent/
          cp AGENTS.md ~/.omp/agent/
          cp APPEND_SYSTEM.md ~/.omp/agent/
          cp INSTRUCTIONS.md ~/.omp/agent/

          # Khởi tạo cơ sở dữ liệu agent.db đầy đủ schema và tiêm Codex OAuth + OpenRouter API key
          echo "Initializing agent.db with schema and credentials..."
          python3 -c "
          import sqlite3, base64, os, json, time

          db_dir = os.path.expanduser('~/.omp/agent')
          os.makedirs(db_dir, exist_ok=True)
          db_path = os.path.join(db_dir, 'agent.db')
          con = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
          cur = con.cursor()

          # Tạo đầy đủ bảng schema OMP yêu cầu
          cur.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)''')
          cur.execute('''INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_version VALUES (6)''')

          cur.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_schema_version (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)''')
          cur.execute('''INSERT OR IGNORE INTO auth_schema_version VALUES (1, 8)''')

          cur.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_change_revision (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL)''')
          cur.execute('''INSERT OR IGNORE INTO auth_change_revision VALUES (1, 55824)''')

          cur.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_credential_block_mirror_guard (credential_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY) WITHOUT ROWID''')

          cur.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_credential_blocks (
              credential_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
              provider_key TEXT NOT NULL,
              block_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
              blocked_until_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
              updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
              PRIMARY KEY (credential_id, provider_key, block_scope)
          )''')

          cur.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_credentials (
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
              provider TEXT NOT NULL,
              credential_type TEXT NOT NULL,
              data TEXT NOT NULL,
              disabled_cause TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
              identity_key TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
              created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)),
              updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER))
          )''')

          now_ts = int(time.time())

          # 1. Tiêm OpenRouter API key nếu có
          openrouter_key = os.environ.get('OPENROUTER_API_KEY')
          if openrouter_key:
              data_json = json.dumps({'key': openrouter_key, 'source': 'login'})
              cur.execute('''INSERT OR REPLACE INTO auth_credentials (provider, credential_type, data, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('openrouter', 'api_key', ?, ?, ?)''', (data_json, now_ts, now_ts))
              print('OpenRouter API key successfully injected into agent.db!')

          # 2. Tiêm Codex OAuth nếu có
          codex_auth = os.environ.get('OMP_CODEX_AUTH')
          if codex_auth:
              try:
                  raw_data = base64.b64decode(codex_auth).decode('utf-8')
                  parsed = json.loads(raw_data)
                  identity_key = f\"email:{parsed.get('email', '')}|org:{parsed.get('orgId', '')}\"
                  cur.execute('''INSERT OR REPLACE INTO auth_credentials (provider, credential_type, data, identity_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('openai-codex', 'oauth', ?, ?, ?, ?)''', (raw_data, identity_key, now_ts, now_ts))
                  print('Codex OAuth credentials successfully injected into agent.db!')
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Warning: Failed to decode/inject Codex OAuth:', e)

          con.commit()
          con.close()
          print('agent.db initialized successfully!')
          "

          # Tạo file config.yml chuẩn khớp 100% với model roles & fallback mới nhất
          cat << 'EOF' > ~/.omp/agent/config.yml
          setupVersion: 2
          symbolPreset: nerd
          modelRoles:
            default: openai-codex/gpt-6-luna:xhigh
            plan: openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:high
            judge: openrouter/~typesafe/jev-latest:auto
            smol: openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
            task: openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
            vision: openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-flash
            commit: openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
            advisor: openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
            slow: openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
            tiny: openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
            memory: openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
            image: openrouter/inclusionai/ming-image-0.1-design
          compaction:
            methodOrder:
              - shake
              - soft
            thresholdPercent: 75
            keepRecentTokens: 16000
            idleEnabled: false
            supersedeReads: false
            dropUseless: false
            pruneToolOutputs: false
          advisor:
            enabled: true
          prewalk:
            enabled: false
          promptCaching:
            enabled: true
            strategy: static-head
          tools:
            artifactSpillThreshold: 30
            speculativeExecution:
              enabled: true
              maxInFlight: 2
          astGrep:
            enabled: true
          astEdit:
            enabled: true
          retry:
            modelFallback: false
            fallbackChains:
              "openai-codex/*":
                - openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
              default:
                - openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
              plan:
                - openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
              smol:
                - openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
              task:
                - openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash
          providers:
            openrouterVariant: nitro
            cacheWarming: idle
            cacheRetention: long
          EOF

          # Tạo file mcp.json cho OMP
          cat << EOF > ~/.omp/agent/mcp.json
          {
            "mcpServers": {
              "github": {
                "command": "npx",
                "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"],
                "env": {
                  "GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN": "$GH_PAT"
                }
              },
              "ripwire": {
                "command": "ripwire",
                "args": [
                  "--mcp",
                  "--top-k=150",
                  "--max-file-size=2M",
                  "--exclude=node_modules",
                  "--exclude=.git",
                  "--exclude=.next",
                  "--exclude=.dart_tool",
                  "--exclude=coverage",
                  "--exclude=.cache"
                ]
              }
          EOF
…
          "

        env:

        run: |

            BRANCH_NAME="$MANUAL_BRANCH"

          # Kiểm tra xem Issue có phải là Handoff từ local hay không
          HANDOFF_BRANCH=$(echo "$ISSUE_BODY" | grep -oP 'Branch dở dang\*\*:\s*`?\K[^`\s]+' | head -n 1 || true)
          if [ -n "$HANDOFF_BRANCH" ]; then

              if [ -d "$repo_dir" ]; then

                git fetch origin "$HANDOFF_BRANCH":"$HANDOFF_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null && git checkout "$HANDOFF_BRANCH" && git pull origin "$HANDOFF_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || true

          TASK_PROMPT="Nhiệm vụ: $ISSUE_TITLE
          Chi tiết bàn giao / yêu cầu:
          $ISSUE_BODY

          Ngữ cảnh không gian làm việc (workspace):
          - Thư mục 'backend/': Dự án NestJS TypeScript (sử dụng pnpm, test bằng 'pnpm test').
          - Thư mục 'app/': Dự án Flutter Dart (kiểm tra bằng 'flutter test').

          - Thư mục 'auto3dvideo/': Dự án Auto 3D Video Tauri / Python.
          - Thư mục 'auto25d-remotion/': Dự án Remotion Video Motion Design (kiểm tra bằng 'python -m unittest discover -s tests').

          Quy trình bắt buộc (Tuân thủ nghiêm ngặt Điều luật 16 Regression-Guard):
          1. Di chuyển vào đúng thư mục dự án liên quan (backend, app hoặc web).
          2. Tạo hoặc chuyển sang branch '$BRANCH_NAME' bằng lệnh: git checkout -B $BRANCH_NAME
          3. ĐỌC TEST CŨ TRƯỚC: Mở và khảo sát toàn bộ các file test cũ (trong test/e2e/, tests/, *_test.dart) để nắm rõ UI selector và assertions, đảm bảo không phá vỡ logic cũ.
          4. Đọc kỹ mục 'Các việc CẦN LÀM TIẾP (Pending Checklist)' trong yêu cầu trên và hoàn thành toàn bộ.
          5. CHẠY TEST THẬT & ALLURE: Chạy test thực tế (ví dụ: 'pnpm test:allure' hoặc 'pnpm test:e2e') để đảm bảo test cũ vẫn pass 100% và tính năng mới hoạt động chuẩn.
          6. BẮT BUỘC stage và commit tất cả thay đổi: git add . && git commit -m 'feat: complete handoff tasks for $ISSUE_TITLE' trên branch '$BRANCH_NAME'."

          # Kiểm tra và khôi phục session dở dang nếu có từ branch omp-sync/sessions
          SESSION_ID=$(echo "$ISSUE_BODY" | grep -oP 'Session-ID\*\*:\s*`?\K[^`\s]+' | head -n 1 || true)
          TARGET_REPO=$(echo "$ISSUE_BODY" | grep -oP 'Repo mục tiêu\*\*:\s*`?\K[^`\s]+' | head -n 1 || true)
          
          # Tự động nhảy vào đúng repo mục tiêu nếu có
          EXEC_DIR="."
          if [ "$TARGET_REPO" = "HethongBackendApi_QuanlyGiaiDau" ] && [ -d "backend" ]; then
            EXEC_DIR="backend"
          elif [ "$TARGET_REPO" = "HethongFrontEndApp_QLgiaidau" ] && [ -d "app" ]; then
            EXEC_DIR="app"
          elif [ "$TARGET_REPO" = "HethongFrontEndWeb_QLgiaidau" ] && [ -d "web" ]; then
            EXEC_DIR="web"
          elif [ "$TARGET_REPO" = "AICheckVAR" ] && [ -d "aicheckvar" ]; then
            EXEC_DIR="aicheckvar"
          elif [ "$TARGET_REPO" = "Auto3Dvideo" ] && [ -d "auto3dvideo" ]; then
            EXEC_DIR="auto3dvideo"
          elif [ "$TARGET_REPO" = "Auto25D-Remotion" ] && [ -d "auto25d-remotion" ]; then
            EXEC_DIR="auto25d-remotion"
          fi
          echo "Thư mục thực thi chính: $EXEC_DIR"

          if [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ]; then
            echo "Phát hiện Handoff Session ID: $SESSION_ID. Đang tải từ branch omp-sync/sessions..."
            mkdir -p /tmp/sync_sessions
            git clone --branch omp-sync/sessions --depth 1 "https://${GH_PAT:-$GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git" /tmp/sync_sessions || true
            if [ -d "/tmp/sync_sessions/$SESSION_ID" ]; then
              echo "Khôi phục phiên làm việc $SESSION_ID vào ~/.omp/agent/sessions/..."
              mkdir -p ~/.omp/agent/sessions
              cp -r /tmp/sync_sessions/$SESSION_ID/* ~/.omp/agent/sessions/ 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          fi

          echo "Executing OMP in Headless Mode inside $EXEC_DIR..."
          cd "$EXEC_DIR"
          if [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ]; then
            printf "%s\n" "$TASK_PROMPT" | omp --continue -p || printf "%s\n" "$TASK_PROMPT" | omp -p || printf "%s\n" "$TASK_PROMPT" | omp --model "openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash" -p
          else
            printf "%s\n" "$TASK_PROMPT" | omp -p || printf "%s\n" "$TASK_PROMPT" | omp --model "openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash" -p
          fi
          cd - >/dev/null
      - name: 7. Tự động đẩy code thẳng vào nhánh thực thi & Kích hoạt Test
        env:
          GH_PAT: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.run_number }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title || github.event.inputs.task_title }}
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body || github.event.inputs.task_body }}
          OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
        run: |
          cd workspace
          BRANCH_NAME="omp/issue-$ISSUE_NUMBER"
          HANDOFF_BRANCH=$(echo "$ISSUE_BODY" | grep -oP 'Branch dở dang\*\*:\s*`?\K[^`\s]+' | head -n 1 || true)
          if [ -n "$HANDOFF_BRANCH" ]; then
            BRANCH_NAME="$HANDOFF_BRANCH"

          PUSHED_REPOS=""

          # Danh sách 6 repo cần kiểm tra và push thẳng

            if [ -d "$repo_dir" ]; then

              if git rev-parse --verify "$BRANCH_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

        if: always()

          from nacl import encoding, public

              print('Không tìm thấy agent.db.')
              sys.exit(0)

          con = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
          cur = con.cursor()
          cur.execute(\"SELECT data FROM auth_credentials WHERE provider = 'openai-codex'\")
          row = cur.fetchone()
          if not row or not row[0]:
              print('Không tìm thấy bản ghi oauth openai-codex trong db.')
              sys.exit(0)

          new_data = row[0]
          b64_new_auth = base64.b64encode(new_data.encode('utf-8')).decode('utf-8')

          # Lấy repo public key từ GitHub API
          headers = {
              'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}',
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
              'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28'
          }
          pk_res = requests.get(f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/actions/secrets/public-key', headers=headers)
          if pk_res.status_code != 200:
              print(f'Lỗi lấy public key: {pk_res.status_code} {pk_res.text}')
              sys.exit(0)

          pk_data = pk_res.json()
          public_key = pk_data['key']
          key_id = pk_data['key_id']

          # Mã hóa secret theo chuẩn Libsodium SealedBox của GitHub
          public_key_obj = public.PublicKey(public_key.encode('utf-8'), encoding.Base64Encoder)
          sealed_box = public.SealedBox(public_key_obj)
          encrypted = sealed_box.encrypt(b64_new_auth.encode('utf-8'))
          encrypted_value = base64.b64encode(encrypted).decode('utf-8')

          # Cập nhật Secret OMP_CODEX_AUTH
          put_res = requests.put(
              f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/actions/secrets/OMP_CODEX_AUTH',
              headers=headers,
              json={'encrypted_value': encrypted_value, 'key_id': key_id}
          )

          if put_res.status_code in [201, 204]:
              print('ĐÃ TỰ ĐỘNG CẬP NHẬT SECRET OMP_CODEX_AUTH THÀNH CÔNG! Token Codex sống vĩnh viễn!')
          else:
              print(f'Lỗi cập nhật secret: {put_res.status_code} {put_res.text}')
          "

# Quyền tường minh: step báo cáo cần ghi Issue. Không dựa vào mặc định của repo (chưa đọc được).
permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  actions: read

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_project:
        description: 'Chọn dự án muốn chạy Test'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: 'all'
        options:
          - 'all'
          - 'fullstack-e2e'
          - 'web'
          - 'backend'
          - 'app'
          - 'aicheckvar'
          - 'auto25d'
      custom_branch:
        description: 'Tên branch muốn kiểm tra (để trống sẽ dùng nhánh mặc định)'
        required: false
        default: ''
      backend_ref:
        description: 'Nhánh/SHA của Backend cho fullstack-e2e (để trống = dùng custom_branch, rồi nhánh mặc định)'
        required: false
        default: ''
      web_ref:
        description: 'Nhánh/SHA của Web cho fullstack-e2e (để trống = dùng custom_branch, rồi nhánh mặc định)'
        required: false
        default: ''

concurrency:
  group: test-runner-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.event.inputs.target_project }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # =========================================================================
  # JOB 1: FULLSTACK INTEGRATION TEST (BẬT POSTGRES + BACKEND API + CHẠY WEB)
  # =========================================================================
  test-fullstack:
    name: 🚀 Full-Stack E2E (Postgres + Backend NestJS + Web Next.js)
    # schedule không có inputs => phải cho phép riêng, nếu không job bị skip và cron báo xanh giả.
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event.inputs.target_project == 'all' || github.event.inputs.target_project == 'fullstack-e2e'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    # CUNG CẤP DATABASE POSTGRESQL & REDIS THỰC TẾ TRÊN RUNNER
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgis/postgis:16-3.4
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: your_password
          POSTGRES_DB: tournament_db
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      redis:
        image: redis:7.4-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: 1. Setup Node.js 22 LTS & PNPM
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 12.4.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      # CACHE 1: PNPM Global Store
      - name: 2. Setup PNPM Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4

          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-

        id: playwright-cache

          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-

      # CLONE BACKEND & START SERVICE KÈM DB SEEDING
      - name: 4. Clone Backend, Migrate & Start NestJS Service
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: your_password
          DB_DATABASE: tournament_db
          DB_SSL: false
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          JWT_ACCESS_SECRET: test-jwt-access-secret-key-32chars
          JWT_REFRESH_SECRET: test-jwt-refresh-secret-key-32chars
        run: |
          mkdir -p workspace
          cd workspace
          REF="${{ github.event.inputs.backend_ref || github.event.inputs.custom_branch }}"
          git clone --depth 1 https://${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository_owner }}/HethongBackendApi_QuanlyGiaiDau.git backend
          if [ -n "$REF" ]; then
            git -C backend fetch --depth 1 origin "$REF"
            git -C backend checkout FETCH_HEAD
          fi
          cd backend
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline || pnpm install --prefer-offline
          pnpm build
          
          # Dùng đúng đường migration của Backend deploy.yml (đã kiểm chứng), KHÔNG dùng drizzle-kit push.

          # Chạy lần hai để xác nhận migration idempotent (như deploy.yml)

          pnpm verify:football-schema

        run: |

          git clone --depth 1 https://${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository_owner }}/HethongFrontEndWeb_QLgiaidau.git web
          if [ -n "$REF" ]; then

            git -C web checkout FETCH_HEAD
          fi
          cd web
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline || pnpm install --prefer-offline
          if [ "${{ steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}" != "true" ]; then
            npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
          fi
          cd ../..

          cd workspace/web

import axios from 'axios';
import type { AxiosRequestConfig } from 'axios';

name: Cloud Multi-Project Test Runner
…
jobs:
…
  test-fullstack:
…
  test-web:
    name: 🌐 Isolated Web UI (Playwright 33 Specs)
…
    steps:
      - name: 1. Checkout Web Repository
…

      - name: 6. Install Packages & Run Tests
        env:
          FRONTEND_URL: http://localhost:3000
          CI: true
        run: |
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline || pnpm install --prefer-offline
          if [ "${{ steps.playwright-cache-web.outputs.cache-hit }}" != "true" ]; then
            npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
          fi
          pnpm build
          pnpm start &
          npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 --timeout 60000
          pnpm test:e2e

      - name: 7. Generate Allure Report Dashboard
        if: always()
        run: |
          npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report || echo "Allure generate completed"

      - name: 8. Upload Allure Dashboard & Reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: web-allure-dashboard
          path: |
            allure-report/
            playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7

  # ==========================================
  # JOB 3: TEST BACKEND API (JEST & TYPES)
  # ==========================================
  test-backend:
    name: 🛡️ Test Backend API (Jest & Types)
    if: github.event.inputs.target_project == 'all' || github.event.inputs.target_project == 'backend'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: 1. Checkout Backend Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.repository_owner }}/HethongBackendApi_QuanlyGiaiDau
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.custom_branch || 'main' }}

      - name: 2. Setup Node.js & PNPM
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 12.4.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: 3. Setup PNPM Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.local/share/pnpm/store
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-backend-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-backend-

      - name: 4. Install & Test (Báo lỗi thật, không nuốt lỗi)
        run: |
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline || pnpm install --prefer-offline
          pnpm build
          pnpm test

  # ==========================================
  # JOB 4: TEST FLUTTER APP (ANALYZE & TEST)
  # ==========================================
  test-app:
    name: 📱 Test Flutter App (Dart Analyze & Widget)
    if: github.event.inputs.target_project == 'all' || github.event.inputs.target_project == 'app'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: 1. Checkout Flutter App Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.repository_owner }}/HethongFrontEndApp_QLgiaidau
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.custom_branch || 'main' }}

      - name: 2. Setup Flutter SDK
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.29.x'
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true
          cache-key: 'flutter-:os:-:channel:-:version:'

      - name: 3. Run Flutter Analyze & Tests (Báo lỗi thật, không nuốt lỗi)
        run: |
          flutter pub get
          flutter analyze
          flutter test

  # ==========================================
  # JOB 5: TEST AICHECKVAR (PYTHON PYTEST)
  # ==========================================
  test-aicheckvar:
    name: 👁️ Test AICheckVAR (PyTest 51 Specs)
    if: github.event.inputs.target_project == 'all' || github.event.inputs.target_project == 'aicheckvar'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: 1. Checkout AICheckVAR Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.repository_owner }}/AICheckVAR
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.custom_branch || 'main' }}

      - name: 2. Setup Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 3. Install Requirements & Run PyTest
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest pyyaml fastapi httpx || true
          if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt || true; fi
          pytest -v

  # ==========================================
  # JOB 6: TEST AUTO25D-REMOTION (MOTION TESTS)
  # ==========================================
  test-auto25d:
    name: 🎬 Test Auto25D-Remotion (20 Unit Tests)
    if: github.event.inputs.target_project == 'all' || github.event.inputs.target_project == 'auto25d'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: 1. Checkout Auto25D-Remotion Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.repository_owner }}/Auto25D-Remotion
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.custom_branch || 'main' }}

      - name: 2. Setup Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: 3. Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

Given the instruction "đảm bảo test cũ vẫn pass 100%" — I should at least determine WHETHER failures are pre-existing (broken on main before any change of mine = not regressions, reported honestly) vs introduced by my fix (none — impossible here; my change is type-import elision).

Actually — hmm, also worth reconsidering one more time whether to FIX the account-link spec bug itself. Root: specs navigate to synthetic tournament ids that SSR-404. The MINIMAL test-side fix would be... the test authors intended SSR to read the stub — that only works if the SSR fetcher can be stubbed. It can't (server→backend). So to make these specs pass TODAY you'd need either (a) seed synthetic tournaments on the real backend for every run (the nightly seed:prod would need fixtures — invasive), or (b) change the specs to hit REAL tournament ids (fragile, data-dependent), or (c) change the PAGE to not notFound()... breaks real UX. (d) Serve the stub through an INTERCEPTABLE layer: make getTournament fetch via a RELATIVE URL on the same Next server, and add a Next REWRITE /api/v1/:path* → backend. Then... SSR fetch: web-server→(rewrite)→backend — still server-side, STILL not interceptable by page.route. NO.

Wait wait. Actually — hmm, one more option: (e) The stub's page.route pattern `**/api/v1/**` matches the ABSOLUTE backend URL — what if SSR fetcher used `http://localhost:3000/api/v1/...`... same thing, server-side. No.

So (a) or accept-failure. (a) = add synthetic fixtures to backend seed:prod conditional on... hmm, actually the seed script probably runs on the CI runner's FRESH postgres every nightly — adding 2 synthetic tournaments + divisions + participants to seed:prod would make THESE tests pass forever. But it changes seed data for ALL environments — risky side effects (stats, leaderboards get synthetic entries — the specs use ids like 'synthetic-account-link-tournament' — they'd appear in real tournament lists; other specs like 'Tournament_LIST' tests might then see them... they filter by name probably. Risky.)

Given uncertainty, correct engineering call: DON'T hack the product or seed to satisfy possibly-stale specs. Report the truth: suite runs, N fail — pre-existing, owner decides. That IS the nightly's purpose: surfacing broken tests nightly.
